claim: Patchline ships a corpus-bias correction estimator with post-stratification weights and diagnostics. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the post-stratification claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make corpus-bias-correction-gate`.
